UpdateStageDescription: Downloads Temurin Java 25 when it is not already installed.
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -eu; cd totk-online-multiplayer-server; if [ -x java/bin/java ] && java/bin/java -version 2>&1 | head -n 1 | grep -q '25'; then echo 'Temurin Java 25 already installed'; exit 0; fi; rm -rf java java.tar.gz; wget -qO java.tar.gz https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/25/ga/linux/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse; mkdir -p java; tar -xzf java.tar.gz -C java --strip-components=1; rm -f java.tar.gz; chmod +x java/bin/java; java/bin/java --version"
